name: Monster Club
source:
Monster Club is an interactive novel in which the player is a student in a college...with a darker side. With the help of his zombie housemate, the player is introduced to a club of monsters, each more haunting than the last! Each one has a specific supernatural dilemma that requires your help, but which will you choose? But be careful; the choices you make my lead you to success or failure!

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/monster-club.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《Monster Club》是一部互动小说，玩家将扮演一名大学生……不过，这所大学还有不为人知的阴暗面。在僵尸室友的帮助下，玩家结识了一个怪物俱乐部，其中的每个成员都比上一个更加令人毛骨悚然！每个成员都有一个需要你帮助解决的超自然难题，但你会选择谁？不过要小心，你做出的选择可能带来成功，也可能导致失败！

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/monster-club.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
